method: Offline recorded-input simulation using shipping v5 rules; every attempt independently replay-verified. Trial rates describe controllers, not people. Each output captures the rules and maps used for that run.

profiles.direct: 12 start delays, objective only, no attacks
profiles.reactive: 24 trials: 6 route/range policies × 4 start/tap seeds; 0.4–0.5 s decisions, ±0.12 world-unit tap error; visible nearest guard, no future simulation
profiles.slow: 24 trials: same policies/seeds, 0.7–0.8 s decisions, ±0.24 tap error
profiles.mild: 24 trials of a known winning command plan; per-command delay 0–0.067 s, initial delay 0–0.5 s, ±0.10 tap error; no replanning
profiles.coarse: 24 trials of a known winning command plan; per-command delay 0–0.20 s, initial delay 0–0.5 s, ±0.22 tap error; no replanning

levels.title: First Pickup
levels.briefing: Tap to move. Tap a robot to shoot. Take the Seeker and escape.

levels.title: Blind Corner
levels.briefing: Use cover to take the guards one at a time.

levels.title: Crossfire
levels.briefing: Two firing lanes. Break one before crossing.

levels.title: Loading Lockdown
levels.briefing: Plan your return before the lockdown.

levels.title: Skybridge
levels.briefing: Move between shots across the roof.

levels.title: Heavy Watch
levels.briefing: Go around the Heavy instead of trading hits.

levels.title: Split Route
levels.briefing: Choose the safe route or risk the shorter lane.

levels.title: Twin Relay
levels.briefing: Bring both phones back. Your health must last.

levels.title: Dark Circuit
levels.briefing: Tap the switch to open the vault gate.

levels.title: Vault Window
levels.briefing: The exit opens for three seconds. Watch its light.

levels.title: Security Grid
levels.briefing: Break the crossfire before taking the phone.

levels.title: Last Seeker
levels.briefing: Disable the Warden or find a way past. Then get out.
